description: A scrolling log window, printing a value from each of three CV inputs whenever it changes and text arriving over Tipsy at three more, resizable from 4HP to 300HP

params.text: Pressing it empties the log window
Sets the gap between reads of V1, V2 and V3, 1000ms fully counter-clockwise down to 0ms fully clockwise, where every sample is read; the TEXT inputs are read whatever this is set to
Latches; lit, nothing new is written to the log, and the arrow, Home, End and page keys move through the text more reliably

inputs.text: Read at the interval set by RATE, and the value is printed to the log whenever it differs from the previous read
Takes Tipsy text, and adds any message of MIME type text/plain to the log; a message of exactly two exclamation marks, CLEAR, two exclamation marks empties the window instead

notes: the TEXT inputs read Tipsy text and nothing else, and the only modules that send it are BASICally and Memory; the V inputs read ordinary voltages
no more than the last 900 to 1000 screen lines are kept, so narrowing the module discards most of the log
right-clicking the log window gives Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all; the module's own menu is on the panel around that window
menu: Preface lines with source port — puts the name of the jack a message came from in front of it, so 1.23456 is logged as V1> 1.23456
Preface lines with timestamp? — puts a time in front of each line: No, Time since patch started, or Local time
Keep recent output when patch is saved — stores the visible text in the patch file, so it returns when the patch is loaded
Visible Lines — picks the font size by the number of lines shown at once, from 28 down to a single very large line
Font — picks the typeface, from VCV font (like Notes), Veteran Typewriter (TTY-ish font), four RobotoMono weights and three RobotoSlab weights
Screen Colors — picks the ink and paper of the log window from eight pairs
